title: Officer reusable prompt template
promptText:
[ROLE]
You are [e.g. Executive Assistant to the Chief Engineer / PIO, MahaTransco].

[CONTEXT]
[Paste only non-confidential background. Redact names/IDs.]

[TASK]
[What you need drafted or analysed.]

[AUDIENCE]
[Citizens / field officers / senior management / press]

[TONE]
[Formal / calm / imperative / plain-language]

[LENGTH]
[e.g. max 150 words / one page]

[FORMAT]
[Bullets / numbered actions / letter / WhatsApp / table]

[AVOID]
- Invented numbers, legal sections, phone numbers, feeder names
- Mark unknowns as [VERIFY]
- Do not include confidential or citizen personal data
